initialVideo.title: ChatGPT Can Now Turn AI-Generated Logos Into Editable SVGs
initialVideo.summary: ChatGPT can already design your logo. Now it can turn that logo into an editable vector file, right inside the chat. Meet Vectorize, a ChatGPT plugin that converts AI-generated logos and images into scalable SVG graphics.
